intent: User requested the original oblique following camera and lightweight fantasy arenas. Generated overhead images are world-ground textures, never screen-fixed backgrounds.

sources.prompt: Create a production game GROUND TEXTURE, square 1536x1536. Exact orthographic overhead view, camera looking straight down 90 degrees, like a beautiful RPG battlemat. All circles must be perfect circles, never ellipses. It will be laid flat on a real 3D ground plane and viewed through a following perspective camera, so do not bake any oblique camera perspective. One circular playable arena centered exactly at image center, outer arena ring diameter exactly 50 percent of image width. The other 50 percent is generous surrounding terrain extending to every edge. Arena interior is completely flat, clear, traversable and uncluttered, beautiful fine stone tiles and a subtle elegant eight-point arcane star inlaid in the center. Avoid raised objects inside the circular playable arena. Surroundings can be richly ornamented but viewed strictly from overhead with roofs and tops only, no visible side faces. Stylized polished fantasy MMORPG environment art, luminous jewel colors, delicate detail, attractive clear readable shapes, gentle shadows. No characters, monsters, houses, words, letters, captions, numbers, UI, HUD, health bars, interface, watermark, grid overlay, or photographic blur. Ground texture only. Theme SKY CITADEL: pure ivory white marble circular floor, fine golden inlaid rings and blue sapphire motifs. Outside the centered arena, a broad marble terrace with elegant blue-and-gold geometric paving, small ivory balustrade tops, sapphire crystal clusters seen from above, tiny green garden beds, and soft blue-white clouds around distant terrace corners. White/azure/gold palette, heavenly clean sunlight. The entire arena floor remains readable and spacious. Cloudy blue edges.

validation: Decoded formats/dimensions/alpha/bytes verified with Sharp. Enlarged source-detail crops and real 1015x481 / 812x375 / 1366x768 rendered comparisons reviewed against 1200 candidates; selected 1024 retains readable floor detail with 15-16% smaller AVIF and 27% fewer pixels. No PNG enters runtime.
composition: Prompts requested a centered arena occupying 50% width; generated results occupied approximately 65-70% and were slightly above center. World scale and center were calibrated to actual output, not assumed from prompt. The outer 10% terrain strips are reflected beyond the image boundary in a single opaque ground shader to cover following-camera edge views without another texture or draw.
